jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Integrations
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Ontic provides software that helps corporate and government security teams identify threats, assess risk, and respond faster to keep people and organizations safe. Its AI-powered Connected Intelligence Platform unifies security operations and data into a centralized system of record, enabling organizations to conduct risk assessments, protect against workplace violence, and manage threats and incidents more efficiently. Fortune 500 companies and federal agencies rely on Ontic to support security programs such as executive protection, threat intelligence, and corporate investigations. Learn more at ontic.ai http://ontic.ai or follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/ontic-technologies/.



Who You Are

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Product Manager to lead Ontic’s integrations product roadmap and help transform integrations into scalable, repeatable, and monetizable platform offerings. This role will define and execute the roadmap for Ontic’s integrations ecosystem, focusing on API contracts, data models, developer experience, and GTM alignment, and ensuring that Ontic’s platform scales through a standardized, API-first, and low/no-code framework.



Key Responsibilities

 - Own the integrations product roadmap, prioritizing by customer value, ARR impact, and scalability to ensure focus on the highest-impact connectors and platform capabilities.

 - Define and maintain API contracts, canonical data models, and integration standards that enable interoperability and consistency across Ontic’s products and external systems.

 - Partner with the Integrations Architect to evolve Ontic’s integration frameworks and marketplace, defining the end-to-end product experience from configuration to monitoring.

 - Lead competitive and technology benchmarking to ensure Ontic’s integrations platform remains best-in-class in developer experience, speed, and reliability.

 - Collaborate with Engineering, Field, and GTM teams to translate customer and market needs into product requirements, balancing technical feasibility with business value.

 - Drive alignment with GTM and Customer Success teams to ensure integrations are effectively packaged, priced, and positioned as value-driving product features.

 - Champion the developer experience (DX), simplifying integration configuration, documentation, and self-service capabilities for clients, partners, and internal teams.

 - Identify and prioritize opportunities to improve the integrations value and experience using AI-enabled workflows, agentic experiences, and conversational AI frameworks.

 - Define and track success metrics for integrations and use data to inform roadmap and investment decisions.

 - Act as the voice of the customer for integrations, ensuring Ontic’s roadmap aligns with evolving customer ecosystems and technology trends.
   

Preferred Qualifications

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent experience; MBA or related advanced degree is a plus.

 - 8+ years of experience in Product Management for SaaS or cloud platforms, with at least 4+ years focused on integrations, APIs, or data platforms.

 - Proven success in defining and launching API-first products, integration frameworks, or marketplaces.

 - Strong understanding of API and data model design, including REST, webhooks, and event-driven architectures.

 - Familiarity with iPaaS tools is a must; hands-on experience with Workato is highly preferred.

 - Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with engineering, GTM, and customer teams to bring complex integration products to market.

 - Familiarity with emerging AI technologies, including LLM-enabled tools, agentic workflows, and integration-driven automation; experience bringing AI-powered product capabilities to market is a plus.

 - Deep appreciation for developer experience, documentation, and tooling that drive self-service and adoption.

 - Strong analytical and prioritization skills, with the ability to tie product decisions to business outcomes.

 - Excellent communication and storytelling abilities to influence internal and external stakeholders.

 - Bonus: experience with integration packaging and monetization, or embedded iPaaS products (e.g., Workato Embedded).

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Ontic provides software that helps corporate and government security teams identify threats, assess risk, and respond faster to keep people and organizations safe. Its AI-powered Connected Intelligence Platform unifies security operations and data into a centralized system of record, enabling organizations to conduct risk assessments, protect against workplace violence, and manage threats and incidents more efficiently. Fortune 500 companies and federal agencies rely on Ontic to support security programs such as executive protection, threat intelligence, and corporate investigations. Learn more at ontic.ai http://ontic.ai or follow us on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/ontic-technologies/.


Who You Are


Ontic is looking for a Director of Product Operations to join our Revenue Operations organization. As part of a centralized RevOps organization, this role sits at the intersection of Product, GTM, and Revenue Operations - helping to translate Product needs, roadmap and outcomes into effective/integrated GTM processes and GTM insights into actionable Product team insights & prioritization. Partnering closely with the Product leadership team, you'll own the systems, processes and cross-functional cadences that keep product and revenue teams aligned as we scale.

This is a highly cross-functional, high-visibility role suited for someone who can function independently, build from scratch and operate equally well in a spreadsheet, a roadmap review and a QBR. This is an individual contributor role with the potential to scale and build the function as the company grows.



Responsibilities



Data Fidelity & Insights

 - Consumption Metrics: Partner with R&D to design and maintain product usage dashboards, ensuring client usage data is accurate and actionable for CS, Sales and Product. Identify usage-based expansion and whitespace signals and operationalize them into CS/Sales workflows

 - Performance Reporting: Prepare regular reporting & presentations on business results & key trends to help the leadership team understand how we are tracking to our goals, where there is risk and where there are successes to be replicated - product-level ARR analysis, consumption, churn, renewal rate

 - Pendo Platform Ownership: Serve as a platform administrator for product usage analytics tools (e.g., Pendo), managing vendor relations, renewals, licensing and legal/PII compliance reviews

 - Data Strategy: Define and govern the framework for product tagging in collaboration with Product leadership (e.g., Pendo) to ensure consistency in usage data capture and actionable insights

 - Closed Loop Feedback: Feedback loop to R&D on GTM-led data signals around product - ARR, pipeline, client feedback, churn
   
   

Strategy & Alignment

 - Stakeholder Management: Act as a "trusted business partner" to Product leadership

 - Roadmap ROI: Enable tracking & measurement of roadmap return on investment (ROI), including ARR coverage and feature adoption curves

 - Product ARR Targets: Collaborate with leadership to set and monitor product-specific revenue targets based on historical trending and expansion analysis

 - Prioritization Signals: Build a structured process for capturing and synthesizing field feedback (win/loss, CS escalations, sales objections, support tickets) into a prioritized input for Product

 - Cross-Functional Collaboration: Build peer support and strong inter-company relationships with other key leaders and partner with them on various projects and initiatives



Operational GTM Readiness

 - Process & Solution Building: Establish and evolve key business processes and cross-functional handoffs to drive efficiency & build for future growth. Act as the intermediary with GTM & R&D teams to help translate initiatives into actionable solutions/processes that fit into existing infrastructure

 - Tool & Data Enablement: Partner with Ops & Enablement to ensure the field has the technical tools and "just-in-time" insights needed for execution

 - Systems Alignment: Maintain & evolve alignment between JIRA & GTM-facing tools/data to ensure engineering efforts are directly linked to revenue outcomes

 - Client Commitments: Establish tracking/reporting for feature requests & roadmap commitments made to clients/prospects & ensure a single source of truth across Product & GTM teams





Preferred Qualifications

 - 7+ years experience in Product Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales/CS Operations or Product Mgmt, with at least 2+ years in a leadership or “own the function” individual contributor capacity

 - Mature understanding of GTM + client-facing SaaS strategies with experience translating them into system and process requirements that deliver lasting business impact

 - Comfortable being the connective tissue between Product and GTM teams & the ability to translate fluently in both directions - with experience operationalizing impactful system and process requirements that work for both teams

 - Experience at a B2B SaaS company in the growth stage; comfort with the ambiguity and resourcing constraints of that stage

 - Track record of building processes from scratch; this is not a role where the playbook already exists

 - Proven experience leveraging GTM technology & product analytics tools; current tech stack includes Salesforce, Snowflake, Omni, Claude, ChatGPT, JIRA, Confluence, Pendo

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills, and experience as a strategic business partner

 - Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
